description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Paul thanks God for the Philippians' partnership in the gospel and prays that their love may grow. His chains have moved the gospel forward, for him to live is Jesus and to die is gain, and he urges them to live worthy of the gospel.

2.en: Paul urges the Philippians to think the way Jesus thought: Jesus took the form of a servant, was obedient to death on a cross, and was exalted by God. They are to shine like stars, and Paul plans to send Timothy and Epaphroditus to them.

3.en: Paul has every reason for confidence in the flesh but counts it all loss compared with knowing Jesus. He presses on toward the goal, for their citizenship is in heaven.

4.en: Paul urges them to stand firm, to rejoice in the Lord always and to bring every need to God in prayer. He thanks them for their gift, says he has learned to be content in all circumstances, and sends final greetings.
